research_allocation_view.plain_statement: This is a research prioritization model, not financial advice.

consensus_method_note: Disparity is a 0-100 metric estimating disagreement across Pass A, Pass B, and Pass C using direction-score and reversal-risk dispersion. Low disparity supported BSX, Visa, WM, PG, and GD conviction quality, while higher disparity and reversal risk reduced allocation priority for STX, ENPH, TER, SOFI, and HUM. Only BSX qualified for the research allocation view, leaving 60% unallocated rather than forcing weaker or high-reversal-risk setups into the basket.
